title: Miso Brown Butter Mashed Potatoes
summary: The usual mash with brown butter and white miso whisked in. Salty, nutty, and a bridge to anything teriyaki or soy-glazed.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cover the potatoes with cold water by an inch, add the salt, and bring to a boil. Simmer until a knife slides in with no resistance, 15 to 18 minutes.

steps.title: Brown the butter
steps.text: While they cook, melt the butter in a small light-colored pan over medium. Swirl until the foam subsides and the solids turn the color of a hazelnut and smell toasty, 4 to 6 minutes. Pull it the moment it's there; it goes from brown to burnt in thirty seconds.

steps.title: Miso into butter
steps.text: Off the heat, whisk the miso into the brown butter until smooth. Doing it here instead of in the potatoes means no miso lumps.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and let them steam dry in the pot for a minute. Mash, then fold in the miso butter and the warm cream. Hold back on added salt: the miso brings plenty. Taste, then pepper.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scallions over the top if using.

notes: The tested ratio is 3 Tbsp white miso and 6 Tbsp butter for 3 lb potatoes. The cream quantity and method are reconstructed.
